priority.why: Provides semantic search with full context including dependencies, callers, and impact analysis

priority.when: For finding specific code patterns, functions, or implementations
priority.why: Faster than semantic search when you know what you're looking for

priority.when: After identifying relevant files to get full implementation context
priority.why: Essential for understanding existing patterns and ensuring consistency

tool.name: semantic_search_with_context
tool.purpose: Search codebase using natural language with complete context
tool.when_to_use: When starting new features or understanding existing functionality

best_practices.practice: Use descriptive queries that capture the full functionality
Review the complete impact graph to understand dependencies
Pay attention to what calls the found symbols and what they call

example.query: user authentication with JWT tokens and role-based access control
example.expected_output: Authentication middleware, JWT utilities, role definitions, and related components

tool.name: analyze_impact
tool.purpose: Analyze complete impact of changing a symbol across the entire stack
tool.when_to_use: Before making changes to existing code to understand full scope

best_practices.practice: Always check impact before refactoring shared utilities or components
Review both function calls and type usage
Consider component rendering and composition impacts

example.expected_analysis: All components using this utility, API endpoints returning formatted currency, and any type definitions

tool.name: apply_diff
tool.purpose: Make precise, targeted changes to existing files
tool.when_to_use: When modifying existing code with known structure

best_practices.practice: Always read the file first to ensure exact content match
Make multiple related changes in a single diff operation
Include line numbers for accuracy and reliability
Use descriptive commit messages that explain the change purpose

tool.name: write_to_file
tool.purpose: Create new files or completely rewrite existing files
tool.when_to_use: When creating new components, services, or complete file rewrites

best_practices.practice: Always provide complete file content, not placeholders
Include proper imports and exports
Add appropriate TypeScript types and interfaces
Include error handling and validation

tool.name: execute_command
tool.purpose: Run CLI commands for development, testing, and deployment
tool.when_to_use: When setting up development environment, running tests, or deploying

best_practices.practice: Use appropriate working directory for context-specific commands
Include error handling and validation in scripts
Use environment variables for configuration
Provide clear output for debugging and monitoring

example.scenario: Setting up database and running migrations
example.code: cd packages/data-ops && npm run setup:database cd packages/data-ops && npm run migrate cd packages/data-ops && npm run seed

tool.name: ask_followup_question
tool.purpose: Gather additional information from users to make informed decisions
tool.when_to_use: When requirements are unclear or multiple approaches are possible

best_practices.practice: Provide 2-4 specific, actionable suggestions
Order suggestions by likelihood or importance
Make suggestions complete without placeholders
Include mode switches when appropriate for specialized tasks

example.code: <ask_followup_question> <question>What authentication approach should we implement for this application?</question> <follow_up> <suggest>JWT with refresh tokens for stateless authentication</suggest> <suggest>Session-based authentication with server-side sessions</suggest> <suggest>OAuth 2.0 integration with third-party providers</suggest> <suggest mode="auth-specialist">Use auth specialist mode for detailed security implementation</suggest> </follow_up> </ask_followup_question>

tool.name: switch_mode
tool.purpose: Hand off to specialized modes for specific tasks
tool.when_to_use: When a task requires specialized expertise beyond full-stack scope

best_practices.practice: Switch to modes with deeper expertise in specific domains
Provide clear context about the work to be continued
Choose the most appropriate specialist mode for the task

example.code: <switch_mode> <mode_slug>database-administrator</mode_slug> <reason>Need specialized database optimization and query performance tuning</reason> </switch_mode>

pattern.name: feature_development_sequence
pattern.description: Optimal tool usage sequence for developing new features

step.purpose: Understand existing related functionality and patterns
Create new components, services, or modify existing ones
Verify changes don't break existing functionality

pattern.name: debugging_sequence
pattern.description: Systematic approach to debugging full-stack issues

step.purpose: Find all code related to the problematic functionality
Run specific tests or check logs
Apply targeted fixes based on analysis

pattern.name: refactoring_sequence
pattern.description: Safe refactoring approach with full impact analysis

step.purpose: Understand full scope of changes before refactoring
Run tests to ensure refactoring doesn't break functionality
